first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A single continuously trackable human figure in the sky, initially curled up and inverted in the final segment, wearing a dark red and dark blue form-fitting outfit, with a red hood covering the head.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: A large expanse of gray clouds behind Person A and the Cluster of city buildings, with variations in light and dark and some blue-gray gaps in the sky.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: The nearby building with a dark grid facade and the nearby reddish-brown building at the beginning, as well as distant building structures and rooftops visible along the bottom edge in the final segment.

entities.name: Thin line pulled by the person
entities.identification: A thin linear object extending from above Person A toward the upper right, with no material, tension state, or offscreen anchor point specified.

entities.name: Aircraft A
entities.identification: A distant fixed-wing airplane that emerges from the edge of the nearby reddish-brown building, then passes through the sky on the left and exits the frame through the top edge.
